entries.title: Hebrews 8:1
segments: Now the sum of the things which we have spoken [is this]: We have such a High Priest, who has sat down on [the] right of the throne of the Majesty in Heaven,

entries.title: Hebrews 8:2
segments: a Minister of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:3
segments: For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices. Therefore [it is] necessary that this One have something to offer also.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:4
segments: For if indeed He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are priests who offer gifts according to the Law,

entries.title: Hebrews 8:5
segments: who serve the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was warned of God when he was about to make the tabernacle. For, He says "See [that] you make all things according to the pattern shown to you in the mountain."

entries.title: Hebrews 8:6
segments: But now He has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much He is also the Mediator of a better covenant, which was built upon better promises.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:7
segments: For if that first [covenant] had been without fault, [then] no place would have been sought for the second.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:8
segments: For finding fault with them, He said to them, "Behold, days are coming, says [the] Lord, and I will make an end on the house of Israel and on the house of Judah; a new covenant shall be,

entries.title: Hebrews 8:9
segments: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day I took hold of their hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt," because they did not continue in My covenant, and I did not regard them, says the Lord.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:10
segments: "For this [is] the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws into their mind and write them in their hearts, and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:11
segments: And they shall not each man teach his neighbor, and each man his brother, saying, Know the Lord, for all shall know Me, from the least to the greatest.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:12
segments: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities I will remember no more."

entries.title: Hebrews 8:13
segments: In that He says, A new [covenant], He has made the first one old. Now that which decays and becomes old [is] ready to vanish away.
